articles.title: Kim Jong Un calls for North Korea to build 2 large warships per year in major naval expansion push: report
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has called for a significant expansion of the nation's naval forces, proposing the construction of two large warships annually over the next five years. This directive aims to modernize the fleet and bolster military capabilities amidst regional tensions, signaling North Korea's strategic focus on maritime power projection and defence readiness in its pursuit of a more potent military.

articles.title: North Korea commissions first 5,000-ton destroyer, vows to build a nuclear navy
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has mandated the production of two new destroyers annually, with these ambitious military developments reportedly funded by billions from Pyongyang's ongoing cryptocurrency theft operations. This directive follows the recent launch of North Korea's largest-ever warship, underscoring a significant push to expand its naval capabilities and strengthen military power despite international sanctions, a critical aspect for SSB aspirants to note regarding global security.
